title: AIDE's baseline and its re-baseline record
caption: provision-vm.sh (one-time re-baseline, lead decisions (22d), (23b)); check-vm.sh group system; record /var/lib/velexis/provision/aide-rebaseline; database /var/lib/aide/aide.db.

states.label: Database from step harden
states.detail: `aideinit` during `harden`; later steps' files are not in it yet.

states.label: started
states.detail: Re-baseline running at the end of the first run after which every step but `summary` completed.

states.label: rebaselined <time> <sha256>
states.detail: check-vm.sh compares aide.db's SHA-256 with the record's last `rebaselined`/`manual` line.

states.label: failed
states.detail: check-vm.sh reports FAIL naming the failed or interrupted attempt.

states.label: manual <time> <sha256>
states.detail: A re-baseline by hand (deployment §12) after reviewing a report.

states.label: aide.db missing after re-baseline
states.detail: `harden` warns and never makes a new one; restore the night's copy from the config backup after review.
